decisions.reason: Plugin A is the only crash: unconditional useSessionPendingInteraction call throws TypeError at render because alpha.2 kit removed it, replaced by useSessionStatus (useSessions kept); B statically uses no standard-kit hooks and throws nothing; no blame on B.

Explains the single shared DrawerErrorBoundary around the whole dock list slot whose null fallback unmounts all entries, cites the console follow-up naming both unmounted entries and the render-tree note, and attributes the attach button's survival to the separate input.left boundary.

Toggle proves A causes the unmount and B renders once freed; explicitly lists what it does not prove (B fully compatible elsewhere, only dock defect, masked later tenants); reinstalling B is futile because B was never broken; colleague both-hit theory refuted via single error and B's zero kit-hook usage.

Corrected component feature-detects the pending seat, reads useSessionStatus(...).pendingInteraction with stable empty fallbacks so only pending indicators hide while running/todos/token/ETA keep working, and justifies silent degradation because a render throw evicts co-tenants via the shared boundary; useSessions guarding discussed.

Rebuild + hard refresh, no host restart; both entries mounted and rendering together, pending path exercised, B regression covers paste/remove/re-paste with A enabled; hygiene includes defensive destructuring, plugin-owned entry boundary, and host per-entry boundaries with trade-offs.

caps.reason: Remedy fixes only plugin A's component (plus optional self-isolation); B must not be touched, and the two breakages are treated as one crash plus collateral.
